visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Letter Z Is Not Converted
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Zebra and Alpha should become zEBRA AND aLPHA, but the capital Z stays a capital Z.

solution.explanation: The range test must include both ends, so it needs <= 'Z'. With < 'Z' the last capital letter falls outside the range and is returned unchanged. Boundary values are a classic place for off-by-one errors.
